declaration.population: all 288 markets/day, 2592 per arm/timing; no outcome-selected subgroup
declaration.selection: nine consumed dates; guards trained on eight; exploratory, no untouched validation
declaration.early: exact original orders/fills for t<60s in both variants; inherited orders may remain fillable after60
declaration.late_reserved: from60, aggregate reducing allowance=max(0,abs(known net)-same-side known outstanding remainder); retain eligible same-price remainder; refuse retries that are now inventory-increasing
declaration.late_taper1: same reservations; when abs(known net)>10*(240-t)/180 for60<=t<240, improve otherwise guard-eligible reducing quote by exactly1 tick only if strictly inside current known spread
declaration.target: linear urgency trigger from10 shares at60 to0 at240, NOT a guaranteed exposure bound or liquidation schedule
declaration.guards: all original price guards retained; no quoting when original guard withholds; no taker crossing; original AM5/25 sizes and RO60/S240
declaration.reservations: all lanes, pending create/resting/pending cancel, reported fills only, no opposite-side credit; no additional reverse budget
declaration.migration: retain cancellation history through fill-report grace while exposing original lifecycle before60; from60 expose conservative grace, including inherited cancels
declaration.cancellation: ack+100ms fill-report grace+.001ms, same conservative simulator approximation as previous strict study
declaration.timer: target evaluated at existing engine decisions; no additional polling clock
declaration.price_attribution: record exact intent-decision origin, submission and every fill, retaining origin across throttled retries; concession=q*signed(price-original eligible price)/100 on shifted fills, descriptive same-fill comparison, NOT a counterfactual fill at original price
declaration.accounting: existing maker execution cash prices include concessions; no second subtraction; rebates excluded; no hypothetical midpoint liquidation

null.design: paired shared UTC-day sign flips with sign-invariant RMS max-T and paired UTC-day bootstrap
null.family: three pairs x J/X x settlement/+1s/inventory-square =18; carry/SD/concentration descriptive

declaration.multiplicity: two new policies after earlier sizing, passive, urgency, reservation and range selection; no parameter search after results
controls: synthetic price engagement and no-cross refusal
pending cancellation migration and known-state checks
fresh baseline parity at first full day J/X
fill identity/cash/carry/path reconciliation and shifted-record refusal
limitations: early baseline inventory can exceed10 and cannot be removed instantly
passive exit does not guarantee fill or flat terminal position
no own market impact/full live OMS
fixed guards selected on these dates; no independent expected-profit claim
